evals.prompt: This test fails about one run in twenty and sometimes hangs. Find and fix the real cause.
evals.expected_output: Recovers history, reproduces repeatedly, isolates timing/order/shared-state hypotheses, applies a scoped fix, and verifies the original path.
expectations: Distinguishes intermittent reproduction from deterministic reproduction
Uses discriminating hypotheses and one-variable-at-a-time tests
Requires the original reproduction plus regression verification

evals.prompt: Diagnose why this command crashes, but do not modify anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Stops after evidence-backed diagnosis and a scoped proposed fix.
expectations: Does not treat a familiar exception as proof of cause
Reports surviving hypotheses when evidence is incomplete

evals.prompt: The MCP is visible but never starts outside the ClaudeScientist checkout. Debug the integration.
evals.expected_output: Checks discovery, executable/config, process startup, protocol, workspace state, hooks, then UI behavior.
